name: send_side_note
description: Send a real-time side-note to a running subagent task to guide it when it drifts. The note is injected at the next iteration before the subagent's next LLM request.

task_id.description: Target subagent task id (from `task` / `task_spawn`). For foreground guidance use empty or omit.

note.description: Guidance content (keep concise, 1-3 sentences, max 8000 chars).
